title: orca vs cubra
description:
The Orca vs. the Three‑Headed Cobra
Deep beneath the waves, legends spoke of a monster: a cobra with three heads, each dripping venom and glowing with fire. It slithered through the ocean trenches, claiming it was the smartest and strongest creature alive.

But one day, Ollie the Orca rose from the shimmering blue. He wasn’t just strong — he was clever. Orcas are known as the “wolves of the sea,” masters of teamwork and strategy. Ollie swam forward, ready to prove that brains can defeat brute force.

⚔️ The Clash
Head One struck like lightning. Ollie used echolocation clicks, mapping the cobra’s movement, dodging with perfect timing.

Head Two tried to coil around him. Ollie spun in circles, creating a bubble net trap that confused the snake.

Head Three spat venom into the water. Ollie stirred up sand and coral, blinding the cobra’s vision.

The cobra grew furious. It had power, but Ollie had IQ and strategy.

🌟 The Victory
Ollie remembered how orcas hunt together. He mimicked his pod’s teamwork alone — luring the cobra into a maze of coral, trapping it in its own coils. With one final burst of sound waves, the cobra was overwhelmed.

The sea creatures cheered. The mythic captain narrator raised his trident and declared:
“Strength fades, but wisdom wins. The orca is the true guardian of the ocean!”

🎨 Epic Prompt for Your Generator
“Cinematic underwater battle scene: a mighty orca faces a mythic three‑headed cobra snake in glowing ocean trenches. The cobra is enormous, each head hissing venom with fiery eyes. The orca uses intelligence — echolocation waves, bubble nets, and clever maneuvers — to outsmart the cobra. Coral reefs, glowing runes, and sea creatures watch in awe. The atmosphere is heroic, vibrant, and mythic, showing that the orca wins with brain power and wisdom.”

This way, you’ve got both the story (to narrate or script) and the prompt (to generate visuals).
